conversion_terms: sUSDe represents shares received by staking USDe; the USDe value per share changes as rewards accrue.
notes: Separate first-class record retained for wrapper-specific lifecycle, income, and access risks.

conversion_terms: sDAI represents DAI savings-vault shares whose DAI conversion value reflects accumulated savings.
notes: Relationship remains active at contract level while the asset record is limited due to legacy product status.

conversion_terms: sUSDS represents ERC-4626 shares redeemable into USDS at the current vault conversion rate.
notes: Current Sky Savings Rate wrapper relationship.
